title: Daniel G. Hingston, Antiques Dealer, Auctioneer, Appraiser, 85 - Antiques And The Arts Weekly
snippet: Hingston, a lifelong antiques dealer, auctioneer and appraiser, passed away on May 2, 2026, in Naples, Fla., at the age of 85. He grew up in Peabody and at the age of 13 his family moved to Middleton, Mass., where he began working part-time after school for the antiques dealer Max Weber.
